title: Customers
lede: Find a member by loyalty id or mobile and see what the rule engine holds for them: their coupon wallet, their points balance and the budgets they have used. Their loyalty record itself is on the Loyalty screen.

form.hint: Enter a loyalty id or a mobile number to see the member.

result.failedTitle: The member could not be looked up
result.failed: The member could not be looked up. Try again.

none.loyaltyId: No member has this loyalty id.
none.mobile: No member has this mobile number.

result.several: More than one member has this mobile number. Choose one.

points.title: Points balance
points.tierHint: What the member's tier is counted on.
points.pendingHint: Earned, but not yet usable until the return window passes.

wallet.title: Coupon wallet
wallet.lede: Campaign coupons bound to the member that are enabled, unused and in date. The customer picks at most one per sale.
wallet.failed: The coupon wallet could not be loaded. Try again.

budgets.title: Budgets used
budgets.lede: Budgets counted per member, such as "once per customer": what this member has used against each limit in its current period.
budgets.failed: The budgets used could not be loaded. Try again.
budgets.empty: No per-member budget counts anything for this member yet.
